differences.justification: watsonx.ai SDK types are intentionally exposed on the public API of this module.
LangChain4j core types are intentionally exposed on the public API of this module.

Deployments are now served by their own models (WatsonxDeploymentChatModel / WatsonxDeploymentStreamingChatModel), so deploymentId no longer belongs to the foundation-model builders or to WatsonxChatRequestParameters.
Deployments now have their own parameters type, because the deployment service does not accept the same parameters as the text-chat service.

The foundation-model specs endpoint is global: projectId and spaceId were accepted and then silently ignored. WatsonxModelCatalog.Builder now extends the connection-only builder base, so they can no longer be set.
The protected chatProvider field was replaced by an abstract chatProvider() accessor, so each chat backend can hold its own service type. WatsonxChat is @Internal.

The chat support was refactored into three backends (foundation models, deployments and Model Gateway), each exposing only the parameters its watsonx.ai service actually accepts. The @Internal builder base classes were reorganised accordingly, so the self-typed setters are declared on different @Internal classes than in 1.18.1-beta28 and their erased return type changed. Source-compatible: callers only need to recompile.
Same refactor, for setters that used to be overridden in the public builder and are now only inherited from an @Internal base class. See the previous justification.
Same refactor: the @Internal base classes sitting between the public models/builders and their common code were reorganised. See the java.method.returnTypeErasureChanged justification.
Same refactor: the @Internal base classes sitting between the public models/builders and their common code were reorganised. See the java.method.returnTypeErasureChanged justification.
embedAll now inherits its default implementation from EmbeddingModel, routing through embed(EmbeddingRequest) so the listeners are notified. The method is still present and callable via inheritance.
The accessors now follow the fluent naming used by every other provider metadata (created(), modelVersion(), serviceTier(), systemFingerprint(), cached()).
executeChat, executeChatStreaming and applyCommonParameters are inherited from the @Internal WatsonxChatBase and are not part of the public API.

Covariant override: javac emits a bridge method retaining the original ()Ldev/langchain4j/model/chat/response/ChatResponseMetadata; descriptor (ACC_BRIDGE, ACC_SYNTHETIC), so callers compiled against the previous signature still link and run. Source-compatible as well, and consistent with the other nine ChatResponseMetadata subclasses.

The watsonx.ai SDK renamed the ModelGatewayParameters inner types (Cache, Router, ReasoningEffort, ServiceTier) to ModelGatewayChatParameters. This is a rename-only change in the SDK; the public API of this module is unchanged in behaviour.
The watsonx.ai SDK renamed the ModelGatewayParameters inner types to ModelGatewayChatParameters. The field types of these @Internal builder fields changed accordingly.
The modelGatewayService field was moved into the WatsonxTextChatBase refactor. WatsonxGatewayChat is @Internal.
